# Numeric HP ratios remain numbers; actual checkbox controls above

        for mode in ('frames', 'continuous'):
            for value in (0, 1, 0.0, 1.0):
                with self.subTest(field='current_hp_ratio', mode=mode, value=value):
                    self.assertTrue(outcome(scenario('char_1044_hsgma2', 1, mode,
                                                    current_hp_ratio=value))['accepted'])
            for value in (False, True):
                with self.subTest(field='current_hp_ratio', mode=mode, value=value):
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, '^' + re.escape(
                            'current_hp_ratio需要范围内的有限非负数。') + '$'):
                        calculate_damage(scenario('char_1044_hsgma2', 1, mode,
                                                  current_hp_ratio=value))
